If he's able to upgrade to full participation at practice Thursday or Friday, it could signal he's close to clearing concussion protocol ahead of Sunday's game against the Giants.

Johnson returns to limited practice participation after completing Week 10 without any injury designation. The safety overcame an ankle injury to suit up for the Jaguars' Week 9 win over the Ravens but appears to have aggrevated the recovering area in the team's Week 10 win over the Titans. Johnson will need to continue to log limited or full practices during the remaining two Week 11 prep sessions for a chance to avoid any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Giants.

Walker injured his ribs in Week 8 against the Colts, but the fifth-year pro was cleared to play in each of the Jaguars' last two games. Unless his practice participation decreases over the next two days, Walker should be good to go for Sunday's road game against the Giants. The 2022 first-rounder has 22 tackles (10 solo), including 3.0 sacks, and two pass defenses through nine regular-season games.

Allen went without a carry or a target in Week 10 at Tennessee, and it looks like he might have suffered a hamstring injury to boot. He'll probably need to manage a full practice Thursday or Friday to avoid carrying an injury designation into the weekend.

Rodriguez was listed on injury reports both of the past two weeks due to the hand issue, but he proceeded to suit up for wins against the Ravens and Titans and handled his usual backup duties behind lead back Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot). Assuming his limitations Wednesday were maintenance-related and not the result of any setback, Rodriguez should be ready to play Sunday against the Giants.

away.injury_description: Herbig likely suffered his hip injury in the Steelers' Week 10 loss to the Bengals. The reserve linebacker will likely need to upgrade to a full participant by Friday's practice to avoid any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Eagles.

Dunker went to IR with a sprained MCL back in late September, but it now looks like he's close to being available again. The move opens a 21-day window during which Pittsburgh can officially activate him before he'd have to go back on the shelf for the remainder of the campaign.

McCormick dislocated his ankle during the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals on Sunday. The good news for the third-year pro is that he avoided a fracture and does not require surgery, so there's a chance he could return for the Steelers should the team qualify for the playoffs, per Ian Rapoport of NFL Network. Brock Hoffman figures to start at left guard in McCormick's stead.

Queen may have picked up the injury during the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals in Week 10, when he logged 14 tackles (five solo), including 1.0 sacks. The veteran edge rusher will have two more chances to increase his practice participation and avoid an injury designation ahead of Sunday's road game against the Eagles. Queen has recorded double-digit tackles in each of his last three outings and has amassed 3.5 sacks in that span.

Elliott missed the Steelers' Week 10 loss to the Bengals with a knee injury he suffered in pre-game warmups. The strong safety's ability to practice in any capacity after the recent injury is a good sign of his potential eligibility for Week 12 against the Eagles. Elliott will likely need to upgrade to a full participant by Friday's practice to avoid any injury designation ahead of Sunday's contest.
